description: Maps every Ziel-ID from PERFORMANCE_EXPECTATIONS.md §1.2 to exactly one primary benchmark case (1:1 mapping). Each entry carries a "status" field: "mapped" (direct 1:1 case), "proxy" (indirect proxy metric), "not_measurable" (no benchmark possible), or "gap" (benchmark missing, open subtask). "primary_case" is the canonical benchmark name for the SLO (mirrors primary_benchmark). "fallback_case" names an alternative benchmark when the primary is unavailable or hardware-gated. Used by CI gate (Check 7a) and tools/verify_benchmark_mapping.py. Wave2: v2.0 — primary_case/fallback_case added for replication/sharding/transaction modules.

CQ-PERF-02.label: Continuous Query Empty-Window Tick Overhead (≤ 1 µs)

C-1.label: L1 Hit-Path
C-1.notes: BM_EmbeddingCache_Query_Hit pre-populates the cache and queries already-stored embeddings at >100 M ops/s; this is the hot L1 hit-path directly. BM_EmbeddingCache_Query_WithIndex (HNSW-indexed) is kept as fallback for the larger-scale hit-path variant.

GEO-3.label: intersects-Query P99 (1M Punkte) <= 5 ms (R-Tree)
GEO-3.note: Direktmessung verfuegbar: BM_RTree_Intersects/1000000 = 6,03 ms (2026-04-22, ohne Extrapolation). Die fruehere O(log N)-Extrapolation war zu optimistisch, da die reale Benchmark-Latenz den vollstaendigen Query-Pfad inkl. Treffer-Materialisierung und Speicherallokationen misst.

GEO-4.label: R-Tree Bulk-Load (1M Geometrien) <= 3 s
GEO-4.note: Direktmessung verfuegbar: BM_RTree_BulkLoad/1000000 = 55,2 ms (2026-04-22, ohne Extrapolation).

GEO-5.label: Buffer 10K Punkte @ 500 m <= 200 ms/Core
GEO-5.note: Benchmark laeuft bei max n=1000; 10K-Extrapolation linear: ~187 ms
GEO-5.v182_result: 18,7 ms bei 1K Punkten; extrapoliert ~187 ms bei 10K (bench_geo_v182_reference.json)

GEO-6.label: Spatial JOIN (2x100K Punkte, 1 km) erste 1K Ergebnisse <= 500 ms

GEO-7.label: GeoJSON Parse (100K MultiPolygon) <= 2 s
GEO-7.note: Dedizierter Parse-Benchmark vorhanden. Misst Parse+Objektmaterialisierung fuer MultiPolygon-GeoJSON bis 100K Polygone.

GEO-8.label: GPU Contains (1M Punkte, A10G) <= 50 ms
GEO-8.note: Direktbenchmark vorhanden. GPU-SLO-Messung auf GPU-Runnern; CPU-Fallback-Benchmark als Vergleichsbasis verfuegbar.

GEO-9.label: DBSCAN GPU Speedup (100K Punkte) > 100x vs. CPU
GEO-9.note: Dedizierte CPU- und GPU-Referenzbenchmarks vorhanden. Endgueltige SLO-Bewertung fuer >100x Speedup bleibt hardware-gated (CUDA-Runner erforderlich).

TDM-1.label: TensorDeduplication Snapshot/Restore Integritaet
TDM-1.note: Dedizierter Benchmark vorhanden; misst Snapshot/Restore-Roundtrip ueber reale TensorDeduplicationManager-Pfade.

TDM-2.label: TensorDeduplication Journal-Replay/Kompaktion
TDM-2.note: Dedizierter Throughput-Benchmark vorhanden; misst Journal-Replay nach Snapshot inkl. Kompaktionspfad via Overwrite-Mutationen.

R-1.label: Replikations-Lag P99 (SEMI_SYNC)
R-1.notes: Direkte Lag-Messung via BM_ReplicationLag (P50/P95/P99-Latenz). WAL append bleibt struktureller Throughput-Fallback.

R-2.label: WAL-Shipping Throughput (Zstd L3)
R-2.notes: ReadFrom/1000 measures sequential WAL read rate; compression overhead is system-level.

R-3.label: Leader-Failover
R-3.notes: PromoteToLeader measures the in-process leader promotion/failover path directly; initialize() remains the lower-bound fallback for environments where promotion cannot complete.

R-4.label: HLC Conflict Detection
R-4.notes: BM_HLCConflictDetection benchmarks LastWriteWinsResolver with controlled Hybrid Logical Clock skew directly; WALEntry serialization is kept only as a structural fallback.

R-5.label: CRDT Merge
R-5.notes: BM_CRDTMerge measures CRDTMergeResolver::resolve() directly across varying conflict set sizes; WALEntry deserialization remains a fallback for structural serialization overhead.

R-6.label: WAL Replay (PITR, 100 GB)
R-6.notes: ReadFrom/1000 measures sequential WAL read throughput as a direct analog for PITR replay rate.

R-8.label: Cross-DC Lag ASYNC
R-8.notes: Direkte Cross-DC-Lag-Messung via BM_ReplicationLagWAN mit simulierter WAN-RTT; BM_ReplicationLag bleibt LAN-Fallback.

SH-1.label: Cross-Shard RPC P99 (LAN)
SH-1.notes: ScatterGather with 4 shards measures cross-shard round-trip latency directly.

SH-2.label: Connection-Pool Hit-Rate
SH-2.notes: BM_ConnectionPoolHitRate measures warm-pool reuse directly and reports connection_pool_hit_rate as the release-gate metric.

SH-3.label: Percolator Commit P99 (10 Shards)
SH-3.notes: BM_PercolatorCommitLatency executes a real 10-shard PercolatorCoordinator commit path in-process and records commit latency directly.

SH-4.label: Shard-Split Migration Downtime
SH-4.notes: ShardSplitDowntimeFixture_ZeroDowntimeReadAvailability measures read availability during live split and reports read_unavailability_ms directly.

SH-5.label: Write-Latenz während Migration
SH-5.notes: WriteLatencyDuringMigration compares baseline and dual-write migration latency directly and exposes write_overhead_pct for the gate.

SH-6.label: Rebalancer Decision Cycle
SH-6.notes: RebalancerDecisionCycle measures the planning loop directly and reports decision_cycle_s for the release target.

SH-7.label: Anti-Entropy Scan Throughput
SH-7.notes: AntiEntropyScanThroughput scans shard-state buffers with configurable workers and reports anti_entropy_throughput_gb_s directly.

SH-8.label: GPU Reed-Solomon
SH-8.notes: GpuReedSolomonThroughput measures GPUErasureCoder Reed-Solomon encode throughput directly; production validation remains hardware-gated on an NVIDIA A10-class runner.

SH-9.label: Snapshot (1 GB Raft-State)
SH-9.notes: SnapshotTransfer1GB copies a full 1 GiB snapshot payload and reports snapshot_duration_s plus throughput directly.

SH-10.label: Snapshot Kompressionsrate
SH-10.notes: SnapshotCompressionRatioZstdL3 compresses representative snapshot pages at ZSTD level 3 and reports snapshot_compression_ratio_pct directly.

SH-11.label: Replica Catch-up
SH-11.notes: ReplicaCatchupThroughput replays a replica catch-up WAL stream directly and reports replica_catchup_mb_s / replica_catchup_gb_s.

SH-12.label: Topology Change Propagation
SH-12.notes: TopologyPropagation100Nodes simulates full gossip propagation and reports topology_propagation_ms directly for 100-node-class clusters.

TX-1.label: OCC Commit P50
TX-1.notes: CommitLatency/1 (single-op transaction) measures P50 commit time directly.

TX-2.label: OCC Commit P99
TX-2.notes: CommitLatency/100 (100-op transaction) measures high-percentile commit latency directly.

TX-3.label: 2PC Throughput
TX-3.notes: WriteOnlyTransaction (10 writes, 4 threads) measures commit throughput; tps counter reports k/s directly.

TX-4.label: 2PC Latenz (5 Shards)
TX-4.notes: TwoPhaseCommitLatency drives TwoPhaseCommitCoordinator + 5 in-process TwoPhaseCommitParticipant mocks (null storage callbacks, WAL disabled) and measures full Phase-1/Phase-2 protocol latency directly. MixedTransaction remains as a single-node fallback.

TX-5.label: SAGA Compensation Time
TX-5.notes: DatabaseWriteCompensation executes Saga::compensate() over real compensation handlers directly; SimpleCompensation remains a lightweight structural fallback.

TX-6.label: Deadlock Detection Overhead
TX-6.notes: DeadlockDetectionOverhead_Predict calls predictDeadlockProbability() on a pre-trained DeadlockPredictor (1 000 patterns, 5 % deadlock rate, 20-key space) and measures per-call latency directly. DeadlockDetectionOverhead_LockOrder benchmarks recommendLockOrder() as a secondary overhead metric.

TX-7.label: False Positive Rate
TX-7.notes: OccReadVersionAndUpdate runs single-threaded (Threads(1)) over a 100-key space; with no concurrent writes the conflicts counter reports implementation-level false positives directly. AbortTransaction remains the fallback for abort-rate regression checks.

TX-8.label: Low-Contention Success Rate
TX-8.notes: OccOptimisticPut under low-contention workload measures success rate directly via commit vs. abort counters.

OC-1.label: Batched Inference (Batch 64)
OC-1.notes: CPU baseline; speedup ratio measured against BM_ImageEmbedding_SingleImage sequential path. Benchmark instance: BM_ImageEmbedding_Batch/64.

OC-2.label: ViT-B/32 CUDA (Batch 64)
OC-2.notes: GPU path; requires CUDA-capable device. Benchmark arg 1 selects CUDA backend (arg 0 = CPU). CI gate: THEMIS_PLUGIN_IMAGE_ANALYSIS_ONNX + CUDA runtime present. Falls back to cpu_time proxy when GPU unavailable. Benchmark instance: BM_ImageEmbedding_BackendComparison/1.

OC-3.label: ViT-B/32 CPU (Batch 16)
OC-3.notes: CPU path; BM_ImageEmbedding_Batch with arg 16. Reference value: 154 ms/image on i7-12700K (see plugins/image_analysis/onnx_clip/README.md). Benchmark instance: BM_ImageEmbedding_Batch/16.

OC-4.label: Text Encoding P95 (CPU)
OC-4.notes: CPU path; text/caption encoding latency. BM_ImageCaptioning covers the CLIP text-encoder path via mock plugin. Benchmark instance: BM_ImageCaptioning/224.

OC-5.label: Metrics Overhead
OC-5.notes: CPU path; measures plugin init + stats overhead independent of backend. Applies to both CPU and GPU execution paths.
